mapper.select: SELECT hps.host_id AS host_id, 'missing_patch' AS risk_type, '缺失安全基线补丁' AS risk_name, pb.baseline_patch_id AS related_patch_id, pcm.cve_id AS related_cve, CONCAT('当前系统要求安装补丁 ', pb.baseline_patch_id, '，但未检测到安装记录。') AS evidence, '安装对应安全补丁并重启系统。' AS recommendation, pcm.cvss_score AS cvss_score, pcm.kev_flag AS kev_flag, pcm.exploit_status AS exploit_status, NULL AS issue_severity, hps.pending_reboot AS pending_reboot, NULL AS install_status, hps.support_status AS support_status, hps.asset_criticality AS asset_criticality FROM host_patch_status hps INNER JOIN patch_baseline pb ON pb.os_family = hps.os_family AND pb.os_build = hps.os_build AND pb.is_security_baseline = 1 LEFT JOIN installed_patch ip ON ip.host_id = hps.host_id AND ip.patch_id = pb.baseline_patch_id LEFT JOIN patch_cve_map pcm ON pcm.patch_id = pb.baseline_patch_id WHERE hps.host_id = #{hostId} AND ip.id IS NULL

SELECT ip.host_id AS host_id, 'bad_patch' AS risk_type, '已安装补丁存在已知问题' AS risk_name, ip.patch_id AS related_patch_id, NULL AS related_cve, CONCAT('问题类型: ', COALESCE(pii.issue_type, ''), '。问题描述: ', COALESCE(pii.description, '')) AS evidence, '参考厂商公告处理对应问题。' AS recommendation, NULL AS cvss_score, NULL AS kev_flag, NULL AS exploit_status, pii.severity AS issue_severity, NULL AS pending_reboot, ip.install_status AS install_status, NULL AS support_status, hps.asset_criticality AS asset_criticality FROM installed_patch ip INNER JOIN patch_issue_intel pii ON pii.patch_id = ip.patch_id LEFT JOIN host_patch_status hps ON hps.host_id = ip.host_id WHERE ip.host_id = #{hostId}

SELECT hps.host_id AS host_id, 'patch_not_effective' AS risk_type, '补丁安装后尚未生效' AS risk_name, NULL AS related_patch_id, NULL AS related_cve, '系统存在待重启状态。' AS evidence, '重启系统使补丁生效。' AS recommendation, NULL AS cvss_score, NULL AS kev_flag, NULL AS exploit_status, NULL AS issue_severity, hps.pending_reboot AS pending_reboot, NULL AS install_status, hps.support_status AS support_status, hps.asset_criticality AS asset_criticality FROM host_patch_status hps WHERE hps.host_id = #{hostId} AND hps.pending_reboot = 1

SELECT ip.host_id AS host_id, 'patch_install_failure' AS risk_type, '补丁安装失败' AS risk_name, ip.patch_id AS related_patch_id, NULL AS related_cve, CONCAT('补丁安装状态异常，当前状态: ', COALESCE(ip.install_status, '')) AS evidence, '重新安装补丁并检查日志。' AS recommendation, NULL AS cvss_score, NULL AS kev_flag, NULL AS exploit_status, NULL AS issue_severity, NULL AS pending_reboot, ip.install_status AS install_status, NULL AS support_status, hps.asset_criticality AS asset_criticality FROM installed_patch ip LEFT JOIN host_patch_status hps ON hps.host_id = ip.host_id WHERE ip.host_id = #{hostId} AND LOWER(ip.install_status) IN ('failed', 'partial')

SELECT hps.host_id AS host_id, 'eol' AS risk_type, '系统已停止安全支持' AS risk_name, NULL AS related_patch_id, NULL AS related_cve, '当前系统版本已停止官方安全更新。' AS evidence, '升级到受支持版本。' AS recommendation, NULL AS cvss_score, NULL AS kev_flag, NULL AS exploit_status, NULL AS issue_severity, hps.pending_reboot AS pending_reboot, NULL AS install_status, hps.support_status AS support_status, hps.asset_criticality AS asset_criticality FROM host_patch_status hps WHERE hps.host_id = #{hostId} AND LOWER(hps.support_status) = 'eol'
